description:
Hiking Trail:

***This trail was significantly damaged by heavy rains in the fall of 2024. The bridge at the start of the trail has been replaced and repairs are being made to the trail but there are several gullies that must be crossed which involve scrambling and these sections of trail are considerably more challenging than before and may be very difficult for dogs. ***

A moderate hike that follows an old mining trail for 6.7 km to alpine and the old forestry lookout. Once into alpine there are panoramic views of the Skeena and Kitimat Valleys.

The original Forest Service Lookout at the summit was rebuilt in 2012 as a BCFS centenary project.

Bike Trail: The Packhorse bike trail on the lower part of the mountain was completely destroyed by the heavy rains in fall 2024. The Packhorse trail is closed with several bridges washed out.
directions: From the 4 way stop junction of Highway 16 E. and Highway 37, drive 1/2 km. east on Highway 16. Drive 6 km. along Old Lakelse Lake Road. 800 m. past the Thornhill Transfer Station turn left onto the Copper Mountain road. Follow the Copper Mountain road for approx. 2.3 km. to the trailhead. The road continues up to communications towers on Thornhill Mountain.
